title: Ocean Metrics indicator value: one row of the value contract
description: Contract 1.2.0. Every producer writes rows of this shape to values/indicator=<indicator>/coll=<coll>/data.parquet, one file per (indicator, place collection). A row is one value of one indicator for one place over one period. The file's key-value metadata carries its provenance under the key om:provenance (values-provenance.schema.json). `time` is null exactly when `time_grain` is `all` (the if/then/else below). Rules a row-by-row schema cannot state are in om_extract.contract (oceanmetrics/extract) and its README: a `time` is the first day of its period; (place_id, indicator, time_grain, time, class) is unique within a file; every row of a file has the file's indicator and coll; `sd` is null where `value` is null or where `n` is 0. A file of contract 1.1.x has no `sd` column and stays valid (its rows are read as sd null).

place_id.description: Gazetteer place id, `<authority>:<source_id>`, as the gazetteer index publishes it (e.g. NMS:CINMS, MRGID:8371, ONMS:monterey-bay-national-marine-sanctuary).

coll.description: Gazetteer collection slug the place belongs to (e.g. places, noaa_sanctuaries, mr_eez). Together with place_id it names the polygon the value was computed over.

indicator.description: Stable indicator id, `<producer family>:<id parts>`: erddap:<dataset>:<variable>:<stat>, cmems:<dataset>:<variable>:mean, sdg:<series>, obis:<metric> or obis:<metric>:<eov>. Listed in indicators.json.

time.description: First day of the period (ISO date; Parquet DATE). Null for time_grain `all`. Year: YYYY-01-01. Decade: YYY0-01-01. Month: YYYY-MM-01.

class.description: Categorical indicators only (manifest kind `categorical`): the class this row's value is the share of. Null for continuous indicators.

value.description: The value, in `unit`. For a categorical indicator, the area-weighted share (0 to 1) of the place in `class` over the period. Null only when the period exists but has no value (never NaN or infinite).

n.description: Size of what the value summarises, as the indicator's manifest entry defines it (`n_meaning`): native time steps for gridded data, records for OBIS. Null when the producer gives none (e.g. a UN SDG country value).

sd.description: Contract 1.2. The sample standard deviation (n - 1) of the layer's cell values across the place's cells at that time step, in `unit`: the spread inside the place that the area-weighted `value` hides. Finite and >= 0, or null: null where `value` is null, where `n` is 0, and wherever the row summarises several time steps (an SD of means is not the cell SD) or the producer has no cells (OBIS, UN SDG).

unit.description: Unit of `value`, UDUNITS-style where one exists (e.g. degree_C, mg m-3, %, 1).

^x_[a-z0-9_]+$.description: Producer-specific extra columns (e.g. x_basis for the SDG country-to-EEZ rule). Consumers may ignore them.

time.description: A date for every grain but `all`.
